# Saved By Grace Co.: Bringing Families Closer With Children’s Graphic Tees & Kids T-Shirts

As a parent, you strive to give your child the best of everything. You want them to have the best childhood, the best things, and to form lasting memories of this period that will nurture their bodies, minds, and hearts for years to come.

All this can be incredibly stressful and difficult to balance alongside your everyday routine; you don’t stop living your own life, going to work, or managing personal affairs when you have a child. You’re suddenly attempting to do everything at once.

You deserve a company that you can rely on to provide consistent, high-quality products that your kids will love and that you can feel good about buying for them.

Fortunately, Saved by Grace Co. is precisely that for clothing.

Saved by Grace Co. offers a fun and stylish range of graphic tees and kids’ t-shirts designed for comfort and everyday wear. From playful toddler boy graphic tees to trendy youth t-shirts, the focus is on giving kids fashionable and functional outfits.

## Saved By Grace Co.: Their Story in Kids T-Shirts and Apparel

Whitney Vaughn founded Saved by Grace Co. as a personal mission to share God’s love through everyday products. Today, it connects with people from all backgrounds by offering high-quality, intentional pieces that reflect identity, foster connection, and uplift women as they walk in purpose.

SBG Co. is a lifestyle brand for women, kids, and the spaces they call home. The brand offers custom-made items that resonate with the heart, from graphic tees that start conversations to personalized home decor that shares your story. With strong roots in faith, family, and honesty, SBG Co. has become a safe and fashionable space for customers who seek more than just products; they seek purpose.

## Progressing With Purpose: Empowering Women & Crafting Quality Kids T-Shirts

Whitney’s personal journey inspired her to start the company. She came from humble beginnings but built her dream home, grew SBG into a seven-figure lifestyle brand, and balanced motherhood with her entrepreneurial pursuits.

Now, the brand is expanding and pursuing new ambitions while maintaining its core values. The company focuses on empowering women toward financial independence, making the shirts affordable. Whitney and her team adopted a made-to-order model to keep costs low and ensure quality and craftsmanship in every item. Through their efforts, the team aims to celebrate seasonal collections, milestones in both family and business, and the glory of faith.

Founded by Whitney Vaughn, SBG Co. was born out of a calling to create everyday goods that share God’s love. What started from humble beginnings has grown into a seven-figure lifestyle brand carried in over 800 small shops, even landing a feature on The Today Show.

Alongside raising a family and building a custom dream home, Whitney has reimagined what a family-centered business can look like. It offers purpose and heart, in addition to great products.

## From a Newborn Onesie to a Toddler Onesie: Choosing the Right Onesies for Baby

Each baby onesie in the SBG Co. collection is made-to-order with details that matter. Whether it’s a newborn onesie, 0–3 month onesies, or a cozy toddler onesie, the fit is diaper-friendly with just the right amount of stretch.

Most families start with 5–7 newborn onesies, then move to 8–10 0–3 month onesies as their baby gains weight and becomes more active. ## meet whitney

Hi, ya'll! My name is Whitney Vaughn. I am the shop owner, designer and creative behind Saved by Grace Co. I'm a mother to a beautiful 17 year old daughter; Aiyana, who gives me so much life and purpose. If you know my story or have been following along, you know that she is my saving grace.

-

Saved by Grace Co. operates with a small team of family. My daughter, Aiyana is the Packaging Queen. She packages all orders for each of you! My sister, Destiny is the one behind the computer! When you email us or have questions, it's likely you are speaking with her. My partner, Ty is our Home Decor and Wholesale Manager. He carefully makes each of your home decor signs to order, especially for your home!

## Did you ever think you could see God in everyday places?

Sometimes, it's hard and I feel so far from Him on given days where things just don't seem to go as planned. In those moments, I encourage myself to be still and pray for God to surround me so that I can stay obedient to His word. In those moments we least expect or in places we never thought we would see Him, the Saved by Grace Co. shop is here to change that. From faith apparel, to home decor - it's my goal to help you to see God in all things.

Saved by Grace Co. didn't just start because I woke up one day and said "I think I want to start a business.". Don't get me wrong, I have for many years had a love for doing my own thing and hopes to start a business one day in the creative realm. Never did I know it would be a business to share God's love. It hasn't even always been that I've been able to hear God speak to me, or that I've been doing this for so long that I know what I'm doing. God is using me, but it's all Him.I haven't always known God, or accepted Him as number one. I used to always think "How could I love someone I don't know?". Growing up in a Christian home and going to church doesn't mean you know Christ or even love him for that matter. I can attest to that. Even still, I don't claim to know it all, to be perfect, or even that I can quote scriptures from Matthew or John. I will even admit that I don't always act in a way that honors God in the midst of my crazy, nonstop life, but God knows I try. One thing I am sure of is that I feel called. Not just a small whisper or little signs here and there, but a longing, a supernatural feeling, no sleeping from waking up from hearing God nudge me, can't stop thinking about it type of calling. It even isn't that God has given me gifts that magically appeared. What He did give me is the heart to try. The heart to trust Him and the heart to learn. The mind to know that things would never come easy and that in order to run His business the way it was intended, I would need to trust Him always. That no matter how discouraged I ever felt, that God said "Whitney, there's room for you, too."Through all of my doubts and fears
